punchline: Before the medals, British cycling tested what its riders slept on.
thirty_sec: In 2003 Dave Brailsford took over British Cycling and set out to improve many small things, from pillows to massage gel to how riders washed their hands, testing each one. British cyclists won 8 golds in Beijing in 2008 and 8 more in London in 2012, and in 2012 Bradley Wiggins became the first Briton to win the Tour de France.
